title: 第1章 曹立第2章 系统降临
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
“这件事就这么算了，赔偿五块灵石已经是最好的结果，再追究下去，对你和二队都没什么好处。”
曹立在和解书签下自己的名字之后，推给坐在对面的白忆。
“签了吧。”旁边的好闺蜜，轻轻的拍了拍名叫白忆的女子。
白忆穿着浅绿色的宗门服饰，属于外门弟子，此刻手里抓着手帕，抹着眼泪。
曹立神色平静的说道：“签吧，你好我好大家好。”
作为一个执法者的无奈，他也没有办法。
和解是最好的结果，要不然对于这个妹子，很有可能带来不可预测的报复。
白忆哭了一会，才在旁边拿起毛笔，写下了她的名字，接着盖上手印。
曹立将和解书收起来，收到档案架上面。
而白忆则在她修仙闺蜜的陪同下，伴随着一抽一抽的哭声，离开执法堂。
走出执法堂后，白忆回头，看着头上长三米的大匾。
执法堂三个大字。
然后就是柱子两边用金色字写的对联。
荡除世间所有不公。
维护世间所有公理。
曹立离开执法大厅，朝休息间走去。
他叫曹立，是凌阳宗执法堂第一执法小队的队长，穿越到这个世界，已经有十年了。
一开始当了两年外门弟子，后来各种送礼，进入了执法堂，待了八年了，从一个执法小队的队员，一步一步，走到今天执法小队队长的位置。
而升职的秘诀，就是眼瞎。
对所有犯了宗规的人，眼瞎。

在凌阳宗混，靠能打吗？
不是，能打有个屁用啊，出来混，要讲势力的。
如果背后，有长老，亲传弟子等等有权有势的人撑腰，那犯了宗规，执法堂的人又敢怎么样？
如果背后没有长老和各位大佬撑腰，再能打能干嘛？执法堂全体出动，车轮战也得给他抓回来正法。
休息室内，传来一阵一阵碰酒瓶的声音。
“来，喝！！”
“干了干了！！”
“好！！”
曹立推开休息室的门。
里面横七竖八的倒着自己的同事和小弟。
十几个人，出勤时期喝酒。
喝得酩酊大醉，仅剩五六个人还在酒桌上拼酒。
“哈哈哈~爽快！”执法小队第二队长喊道。
“他娘的实在憋屈，我们执法堂都快成摆设的了，怎么着，那个男的跟亲传弟子有关系，就能够光天化日调戏我相好啊。”
“老子去阻止，还敢推我，要我不是执法队队长，他是不是就敢把我相好扛回屋里了。”
“来，喝！”第二小队队长，跟他的手下碰坛。
“二队，是这样的啦，能保住自己人算很不错啦，现在整个宗门，谁不知道我们执法堂就是个摆设，只能抓抓那些小鱼小虾啊啥的，其他的，没有长老们授意，哪敢掺和啊。”一个小胖子，跟着二队长碰酒坛。
“娘的，这不能管那不能管，我这个执法堂队长，辞职算了，当个弟子多舒服。”
曹立走了过来，拉了一张椅子坐下。
“曹哥。”还在喝酒的下属们，看到曹立过来，一个个打招呼。

“老曹你来了。”二队软趴趴的转过头来，眼神迷离，似乎都看不大清楚了。
“你醉了。”
“老子没醉。”二队喊道。“我相好的事情，处理得怎么样了？”
“她已经签了和解书，这事情就这么过去了。”
content_en:
"Let's just let this matter go. Compensating for five spiritual stones is the best result. If we pursue it any further, it will be of no benefit to you or the second team."
After Cao Li signed his name on the settlement letter, he pushed it to Bai Yi who was sitting opposite.
"Sign it." The best friend next to her gently patted the woman named Bai Yi.
Bai Yi was wearing light green sect clothes and was an outer disciple. He was holding a handkerchief in his hand and wiping his tears.
Cao Li said calmly: "Sign it, hello to you, hello to me, hello to everyone."
As a law enforcer, he had no choice but to do anything.
Reconciliation is the best outcome, otherwise it may bring unpredictable revenge to this girl.
Bai Yi cried for a while, then picked up the brush next to her, wrote her name, and then stamped her handprint.
Cao Li put away the settlement letter and put it on the file shelf.
Bai Yi, accompanied by her best friend who cultivates immortality, left the Law Enforcement Hall with twitching cries.
After walking out of the law enforcement hall, Bai Yi turned back and looked at the three-meter long plaque above his head.
There are three big characters: Law Enforcement Hall.
Then there are the couplets written in gold characters on both sides of the pillars.
Eliminate all injustice in the world.
Uphold all justice in the world.
Cao Li left the law enforcement hall and walked toward the rest room.
His name is Cao Li, and he is the captain of the first law enforcement team of the Lingyang Sect Law Enforcement Hall. It has been ten years since he traveled to this world.
At first, he worked as an outer disciple for two years. Later, he gave various gifts and entered the Law Enforcement Hall. He stayed there for eight years, step by step, from a member of the law enforcement team to his current position as the leader of the law enforcement team.
And the secret to promotion is to be blind.
Blind to all those who break the religious rules.
In Lingyang Sect, do you think you can fight?
No, there is no point in beating him up. If you come out to hang out, you have to talk about power.
If there are elders, direct disciples and other powerful people behind the back, what will happen to the people in the Law Enforcement Hall who violate the sect's rules?
If you don't have the support of the elders and big bosses behind you, what can you do if you can fight again? The entire Law Enforcement Hall was dispatched, and they had to fight to bring him back to justice.
In the lounge, there were sounds of bottles being clinked.
"Come on, drink!!"
"Do it, do it!!"
"Okay!!"
Cao Li pushed open the door of the lounge.
His colleagues and younger brothers were scattered inside.
More than a dozen people drank while on duty.
They were so drunk that only five or six people were still drinking at the wine table.
"Hahaha~ Refreshing!" shouted the second captain of the law enforcement team.
"It's so fucking frustrating. Our law enforcement hall has almost become a decoration. What's the matter? That man has a relationship with his direct disciple, so he can molest my lover in broad daylight."
"I went to stop him and he dared to push me. If I were not the captain of the law enforcement team, he would have dared to carry my best friend back into the house."
"Come on, drink!" The captain of the second team clashed with his men.
"The second team, it's like this. It's good to be able to protect your own people. Now in the entire sect, no one knows that our law enforcement hall is just a decoration. We can only catch those small fish and shrimps. How can we dare to interfere with other things without the instructions of the elders." A little fat man followed the second team leader to touch the wine jar.
"Mom, you can't control this or that. I, the captain of the Law Enforcement Hall, should just resign. It's so comfortable to be a disciple."
Cao Li came over, pulled up a chair and sat down.
"Brother Cao." The subordinates who were still drinking greeted Cao Li one by one when they saw him coming.
"Lao Cao, you're here." The second team turned their heads limply, their eyes blurred, and they seemed like they couldn't see clearly.
"You're drunk."
"I'm not drunk." Team 2 shouted. "How are you handling my best friend's affairs?"
"She has signed the settlement document and that's the end of it."
